correctness.rationale: Every group irrep is explicitly constructed and its defining relations verified; the four one-dimensional plus p−1 two-dimensional sectors exhaust dimension 4p. The odd/even block singular-value formulas follow from direct M* M multiplication, and exact zero congruences yield all nullity cases. Counting unordered pairs by shortest cyclic separation proves the five support weights, including the p=3 collision. A sharp monotone cosine gap gives both condition-number inequalities and exact equality classes. The self-contained checker performed 2450 finite modular-rank cases and 525 numerical singular-value comparisons, but the all-prime proof is symbolic.

value.rationale: Balanced four-point convolution is the minimal nontrivial bipartition of taps across the two cosets of a nonabelian cyclic-index-two group. Complete singular-value and rank strata directly measure recoverability and noise amplification; the exact counts classify all supports rather than arbitrary small slices. Sharp extremes expose a nonobvious rank-versus-stability contrast: precisely two antipodal pairs produce maximal rank loss but perfect conditioning on the image, whereas precisely one antipodal pair produces the worst conditioning, including minimally singular examples. Infinite families over every odd prime give a structural result rather than routine fixed finite enumeration.
